studies.title: Cinchona and quinine
studies.caption: Cinchona bark carried the substance from which quinine was later isolated. The tree's history links the Andean forests with the treatment of malaria.
studies.prompt: Botanical specimen study of Cinchona officinalis leafy flowering branch with opposite simple elliptical leaves and clusters of small pink tubular flowers, a few curled rough brown bark strips placed separately below. Soft cloud-forest hints at margin, no pills, bottles, dosage text or invented laboratory.
